principal_finding.stop_reason_redacted: write \\?\<HOME>\AppData\Local\Docker\log\vm\init.log: There is not enough space on the disk.
principal_finding.interpretation: The log directly attributes this stopped state to a host log write failing for lack of disk space. An API proxy and Desktop/backend processes being present do not establish a running Linux Docker engine.

log_sources.role: explicit stopped state and disk-full reason
component I/O and WSL crash-capture observations

native_status_commands.decode_limit: The existing bounded UTF-8 collector did not fully decode the UTF-16 Chinese status text. The distro identifier and numeric version were readable; this is not a transcript of correctly decoded full output.

daemon_diagnostic.daemon_timeout_native_handle_authority: parent agent's original diagnostic process result, not the exit status of these read-only status collectors

service_interpretation: The stopped manual Windows Docker service is not independently established as the cause for this WSL2 Linux backend. No service was changed.

storage_migration_assessment.interpretation: The data file length is about 121.49 GiB versus D: free space about 47.13 GiB. Its returned attributes were Archive, not SparseFile or Compressed. A normal full-size copy cannot fit under the observed capacity; no move, compact, mount or backup was attempted.

limits: No engine startup or successful daemon connection was observed in this subtask.
No image inventory was queried after the failed daemon probe.
No VHDX or Linux filesystem integrity check was performed; I/O messages alone do not prove corruption.
A bounded System event-log query returned no records and its combined command exited 1; this was not counted as a filesystem-health pass.
Installed Docker version and applicability of upstream release-note fixes were not verified.
This observational draft is not a Gazebo, rendering, PX4 flight, HIL/REAL or release acceptance receipt.

proposed_repair_not_executed.first_decision: Choose explicit recoverable user-owned C: files or directories to relocate or remove, with exact path, size and recovery location verified first. Preserve Docker VHDXs, models, repository, logs and journals.
proposed_repair_not_executed.second_decision: After free space is rechecked, authorize one controlled Docker engine recovery attempt. This does not authorize a WSL shutdown, Windows reboot, factory reset, reinstall or broad cleanup.
proposed_repair_not_executed.followup: Verify the actual native daemon result, then existing images and the real simulator. If I/O faults persist after space recovery, investigate them separately instead of assuming factory reset is required.
